Life is full of small surprises. The weather was snowy that day. There are always many people at the kitchen table. Also, a mother's love for her child is unconditional and endless.
Jack is interested in swimming. Ben bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Last Sunday, Ben and Jack went to the vegetable market. I have breakfast at seven.
They took many photos at the kitchen table. Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Jack's birthday is in February. Mum made chicken soup for lunch.
Ben is going to travel to London in February. It takes twenty minutes to get to the vegetable market by bike. Ben hopes to visit London one day.
